abilities.effect:
Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee
weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Demands of the Witness
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Ruination Chamber^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target's melee weapons. If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

abilities.name: On Wings of Death
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If the target charged this turn, apply the effects below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effects below: 

• You can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: The Flames of Hope
abilities.effect: You can re-roll resistance rolls for friendly **^^Ruination Chamber^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Guardian of the Final Threshold
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked to be the target of a non-**^^Core^^** ability
abilities.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 3+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

abilities.name: Heavens-sent
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique Stormcast Eternals Infantry^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Their Finest Hour
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit that has not used this ability this battle to use this ability
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit's combat attacks and add 1 to save rolls for that unit.

abilities.name: Scions of the Storm
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit that is **in the Celestial Realm**.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: The Celestial Realm
abilities.declare: If there are more friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Celestial Realm**. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: Null Pendant
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 5 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Quicksilver Draught
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Mirrorshield
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.

abilities.name: Beacon of Azyr
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
The next time this turn that the target uses a **^^Prayer^^** or **^^Spell^^** ability, instead of making a casting roll or chanting roll for them, you can use a value of 7 for the roll that cannot be modified. After that ability is resolved, if the target has any ritual points, reset their ritual points total to 0.
**Designer's Note:** *Ritual points apply modifiers so cannot be used with this ability to increase the chanting roll to more than 7.*

abilities.name: Sigil of Morrda
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command or a **^^Rampage^^** ability for a unit in combat with this unit
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that command or **^^Rampage^^** ability has no effect, it still counts as having been used and any command points spent to use that ability are still lost.

abilities.name: Banner of Sigmar
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, your opponent cannot control the target objective while they have no units contesting it.

abilities.name: Pennant of Azyrite Majesty
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy target, then you can pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the friendly target
abilities.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn, while it is visible to this unit:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the enemy target.
• Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for the friendly target.

abilities.name: Blade of the Six Smiths
abilities.declare: Pick 1 of this unit's non-**Companion** melee weapons to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Halve the Attacks characteristic of the target weapon (rounding up).
• Double the Damage characteristic of the target weapon.
• Attacks made with the target weapon score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 3+.

abilities.name: Fractured Astral Jewel
abilities.effect: If an ability would heal or return any slain models to an enemy unit while it is within 6" of this unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

abilities.name: Peerless Manoeuvres
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Vanguard Chamber^^** unit that did not use a **^^Move^^** ability this turn and is not in combat.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Ancient Aura
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ruination Chamber^^** unit.
abilities.effect: That unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Synchronised Strikes
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Warrior Chamber^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly non-**^^Hero^^** non-**^^Beast Stormcast Eternals^^** units that do not have the **^^Warrior Chamber^^** keyword.

abilities.name: Oncoming Storm
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Extremis Chamber^^** unit that charged this turn.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Cycle of the Storm
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sacrosanct Chamber^^** unit that had models slain in this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit.

abilities.name: Staunch Defender
abilities.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective in friendly territory, add 3 to the control scores of friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** units contesting that objective.

abilities.name: Envoy of the Heavens
abilities.declare: If a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit was destroyed in the previous turn, pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Shock and Awe
abilities.effect:
Each time this unit is set up using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the battle round.
In addition, each time a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit is set up wholly within 12" of this unit using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Intense Piety
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Priest^^** or **^^Wizard^^** within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Legendary Tenacity
abilities.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

abilities.name: Hour of Glory
abilities.effect: This unit can be picked to use the 'Their Finest Hour' ability even if it has already used it this battle. In addition, when this unit is picked to use the 'Their Finest Hour' ability, add 5 to its control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Summon Celestian Vortex
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Celestian Vortex** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Celestian Vortex wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Dais Arcanum
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Dais Arcanum** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a friendly Stormcast **^^Eternals Infantry Hero^^** that does not have **^^Fly^^** and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Dais Arcanum** within 1/2" of the target, visible to the caster and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and place it on the platform of that **Dais Arcanum**.

abilities.name: Summon Everblaze Comet
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Everblaze Comet** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an **Everblaze Comet** wholly within 18" of the caster.

abilities.name: Bless Weapons
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Infantry^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 12+, this ability affects all visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** units wholly within 12" of the chanter.

abilities.name: Translocation
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Healing Storm
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Heal (D3) the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.

abilities.name: Lightning Blast
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then pick the closest visible enemy unit to them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target. If 2 or more visible enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Starfall
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy **^^Infantry^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Thundershock
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.
